senses.gloss:
ओदती ओदती, f. (part. of rt. 2. उद्), Ved.
flowing forth, issuing out, rising upwards; epithet of
the dawn.

ओदन, अस्, अम्, m. n. grain mashed and cooked
with milk, boiled rice; a cloud; (नी), f. the plant
Sida Cordifolia. When a name is given to a pupil
to indicate his attachment to any particular master,
ओदन may be prefixed to denote that the pupil's
object is rather food than instruction (e. g. ओदन-
पाणिनीयः, a pupil of Pāṇini whose object is only
to be fed by Pāṇini).
—ओदनाह्वया (˚न-आह्˚) or
ओदनाह्वा or ओदनिका, f., N. of a plant.

ओदनीय, nom. P. ओदनीयति, -यितुम्, to wish to
make mashed food of anything.
